q: By the definition of potential difference, the work done in bringing a unit positive charge from A to B is ____.

q: The work done $W$ by the battery in taking the charge $Q$ from A to B is, in fact, the ____ energy supplied by the battery.

q: Heat energy is produced because the electrons ____ with the atoms in the resistor $R$ when they pass through it.
